extensionDesc.message: Adds useful changes to YouTube, such as showing the mini player when scrolling.

settingsRefresh.description: Text shown when changing a setting requires a refresh

settingsRefreshAction.description: Button text for refreshing open YouTube tabs

settingsMiniLabel.description: Label for checkbox for mini player

settingsMiniDesc.message: Shows a floating mini player when you scroll past the video.

settingsDislikeLabel.description: Label for checkbox for returning dislike count

settingsDislikeDesc.message: Shows the dislike count using the Return YouTube Dislike API.

settingsTheaterLabel.description: Label for checkbox for chat theater mode

settingsTheaterDesc.message: Pins live chat beside the video in theater mode, like Twitch.

settingsPipLabel.description: Label for checkbox for picture in picture button

settingsPipDesc.message: Adds a picture-in-picture button to the video player.
settingsPipDesc.description: Description of picture in picture button

settingsCommentsLabel.description: Label for checkbox for right-side comments

settingsCommentsDesc.message: Moves comments to the right sidebar so you can read while watching.
